description: Pipeline input — the freehand strokes drawn on the canvas, as a polyline network (a graph). Optionally filtered by stroke colour. Feeds the Graph nodes.
instructions:
Pipeline input — emits the canvas's freehand drawing as connected polylines (a graph). Set `Colour` to grab only strokes of that hex colour (blank = every freehand stroke).

Freehand is already VECTOR, so no raster Vectorise is needed — wire this straight into a Graph Reduce (Dissolve merges chains, Prune drops spurs) to tidy the wobble into a clean node/edge graph, then Mitered Join / Graph to Spaces as usual.
